topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stand where the sapling once bent towards the sky, a tender shoot that I cradled in soil with my own hands. Now, a stump marks the spot, a scar against the earth. But around it, the forest whispers in a different key. Young shoots, bold and defiant, reach for the light. They grow where the old tree once rooted, rising with a tenacity that speaks of the future. The air, rich with the scent of pine and earth, carries the stories of those that will follow. This patch of ground, once a seed's first embrace, now teems with the promise of new beginnings. The forest does not remember the single tree; it remembers the land, the cycle of growth and passing that will never cease. Here, life continues, strong and sure.
